<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> The Congress party has accused the Election Commission of providing false information regarding the ECINet portal, while the Commission has launched a special drive to re-enroll voters omitted during recent electoral processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>UCC implementation:</strong> The Gujarat Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill has received presidential assent, with the BJP framing it as a move toward equality while the opposition dismisses it as a political distraction.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
